data.short_description: SAW's BBQ is opening in the former Rodney Scott's BBQ building at Valley Post. Reports differ on whether it opens Nov. 9 or Nov. 2, and the restaurant said it will announce the official date on Facebook.
Waldo's Chicken and Beer opened Sept. 29, beginning the revival of the Valley Post development. SAW's BBQ is expected to be the second restaurant to open there.
Rodney Scott's BBQ was one of four Pihakis Restaurant Group restaurants at Valley Post that closed during the facility's shutdown in April. The shutdown followed financial trouble for the group.
Hero Diner was one of four Pihakis restaurants at Valley Post that closed during the facility's shutdown. Valley Post had sat empty since April.

data.location: 6010 Ridge Ave., Pleasant Ridge, Cincinnati (The Ridge)
data.short_description: Women-focused Ambition Fitness signed a 10-year lease in October for the final retail space at The Ridge, its first Cincinnati location. The studio plans to hire about 15 employees, and an exact opening date has not been announced.

data.status: aiming to open its doors on December 1
data.short_description: OMAGINE, owned by Matt Sonne, is a private entertainment lounge with LED mini golf, pool, arcade games and immersive lounge seating. It is positioned as a rentable party venue, with private events starting at $398 for up to 30 guests.
Wahlburgers is closing its Fenway location after 11 years as its lease comes to an end. The company says it is actively looking for a new location in the Boston area.
The original Wahlburgers in Hingham, opened in 2011, closed after 15 years. The Fenway closure followed shortly after that announcement.

data.status: still planned, rather than open or under construction
data.short_description: Urban Bird announced on October 20, 2026 a development agreement for three restaurants in Wichita. No addresses, opening dates or construction timetable have been released.
Urban Bird reported a separate two-restaurant franchise agreement for the greater Houston area. These are not part of the Kansas total.

data.status: will get a new … Wawa in just days on November 19
data.short_description: Wawa will open its first Nashville store on November 19, its sixth location in Tennessee. The president said the company looks forward to continued statewide expansion.

data.event_date: by the end of the year
data.short_description: Another Wawa is coming to Murfreesboro by the end of the year. Together with Nashville, this would make seven new Tennessee locations in 2026.

The Book Broker, an Evansville staple since 1975, is closed for now because of the owner's illness and legal and financial problems. An earlier post saying it was closing for good was removed.

Kroger's Fred Meyer James Center store is scheduled to close January 30, 2027, affecting 100 union workers. Kroger cited a rent increase, but the property manager disputes that explanation.

data.store_name: Wendy's (Meritage Hospitality Group, up to 60 locations)
data.short_description: Bankrupt franchisee Meritage Hospitality Group could close up to 60 more Wendy's locations through November 13, according to court filings. The restaurants under consideration are generally underperforming locations.
Meritage has closed 33 Wendy's restaurants since filing for Chapter 11 on September 17, including 13 in October. It operated 314 locations when it filed.
